Built Like It Matters

The details

01

Dual-layer mesh

Ultra-heavyweight double-layer knit, cut for max airflow and an unrestricted crossover. No see-through, no paper-thin mesh.

02

Deep zip pockets

Both pockets zip shut and run deep enough for a phone, keys, and a wallet — nothing bounces out on a fast break.

03

Metal-tip drawstring

Elongated drawstring with metal aglets. Tie it once and it stays tied through a full run.

04

The inside message

Embroidered CH monogram on the leg, and the pocket lining is printed “Clutch Built Different (on the inside)” — a detail only the wearer knows about.

CLUTCH // DROP 01

Cream. Gray. Heavyweight mesh. Born in NYC.

Engineered for maximum airflow and an unrestricted crossover. The CLUTCH basketball shorts carry the whole Upper East Side across both legs — Central Park, the avenues, and the East River — on a vintage cream body with a charcoal engineered-knit waistband. Ultra-heavyweight dual-layer mesh, secure deep zipper pockets to lock down your essentials, and an elongated metal-tipped drawstring.

The pocket lining. Nobody sees it but you — that's the point.

Two 12-year-olds. One idea.

CLUTCH started with two 12-year-olds who loved basketball and had more ideas than anyone expected. We wanted shorts that looked like where we're from, so we stopped waiting and made them ourselves. Every detail came from us: the Upper East Side map print, the deep zipper pockets, the long metal-tipped drawstring, and the message inside the pocket that says Clutch Built Different. Drop 01 is 30 pairs. No restocks. Never re-run. If you get one, you're part of the first chapter.

Founded in New York City · Est. 2026

FAQ

Before you ask

When does Drop 01 go live?+

Friday, November 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM ET, right here on this site. 30 pairs total — when a size sells out, it's gone for good.

How do I buy a pair?+

Pick your size above and hit the buy button once the drop is live — checkout happens right here on this site, this is the only store. Before drop day the button stays locked so nobody jumps the line.

How does sizing run?+

Relaxed athletic cut that sits above the knee, with a 5.5″ inseam. The waist runs a little snug — if you're between sizes, size up. Full measurements are in the size chart next to the size picker.

Shipping+

Orders ship within 5 business days of the Nov 27 drop. Tracking is emailed once your pair leaves.

Returns+

Unworn pairs with tags can be returned within 14 days for store credit. Each pair is 1 of 30, so sold-out sizes can't be exchanged.

Will there be a restock?+

No. Drop 01 is never re-run — that's the whole point. Future drops will be new designs, not more of these.
